slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 jumped 1.49% today to 7,764.70, within 0.44% of its all time closing high, powered by a massive chip stock rally led by AMD and Intel. Oil dropped 8.31% to 91.97 per barrel, which pulled yields lower and gave investors room to buy growth stocks. Bitcoin surged 6.89% to 86,730.54, an eight month high, adding to the bullish mood. Thursday brings unemployment claims, the next data point worth watching.
